what: NDT-ATTN-7 (2026-10-16): the AVX-512 attention's context and transposed products -- att512_context (the forward's context and the backward's dq) and att512_transposed (dv and dk) -- take a block's diagonal terms over all eight rows, a row that does not take a term merge-masked out of its sum (_mm512_mask_add_ps: its accumulator the one it held, NaN or not; the skipped row's product, of the +0.0 past its diagonal inside the block, discarded). The loop bounded by the term had indexed the blocks' register arrays by a run-time row: at the trainer's -O3 GCC 13.3 stored 21 of the context's 24 accumulators to the stack every step of its main loop and moved the transposed kernel's through the stack around its diagonal terms (40 stores and 21 loads in its code, the context 21 and 21), Clang 18.1 the context's 42/42 (transposed 4/4), Clang 23.1 42/42 (8/5); with the slice none of the three leaves a stack store or load in either kernel. At the harness's -O2, GCC spills neither kernel before or after; Clang keeps the context's main loop rolled before and after (18.1: 30/24, 23.1: 43/36), and Clang 18.1 now the transposed kernel's masked loop too (51/48; 23.1 0/0).
